title: Ex 2.5 #4 · Truth table for ∼(P ∨ Q) ∨ (∼P)
prompt: Build a truth table for $\sim (P \vee Q) \vee (\sim P)$ and enter the truth value of the whole statement in each row.
answer_format: Four T/F values, one per row, top to bottom, like T F T T. Rows (P, Q) go TT, TF, FT, FF, as in the book. Helper columns are optional steps, like ~P : F F T T.
hints: The ∼ in front of (P ∨ Q) negates the whole disjunction. Find P ∨ Q first, then flip it.
Make a column for ∼P too, then combine the two pieces with ∨.
solution: $P \vee Q$ is T T T F, so $\sim (P \vee Q)$ is F F F T.
$\sim P$ is F F T T.
Or-ing these two columns gives F F T T.

reference.note: This exact exercise, restated in ProofLab's words. Uses the truth tables for ∧, ∨, ∼, ⇒ and ⇔ (Sections 2.2–2.5).

steps.content: P ∨ Q : T T T F
